items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: participating in what you think was a Bach piece and that you said it affected you so much that you couldn’t even speak.

ctx.x: That’s right, anywhere. And you’re just like breathing each other’s energy. Sometimes I almost can’t believe the notes that come out in those circumstances. Did I just play that? I’ve never played that before. You know, that kind of thing.

It makes me think of the anecdote you told me about going to Hamilton College and participating in what you think was a Bach piece and that you said it affected you so much that you couldn’t even speak.
I really had trouble talking for a couple of days.
